**Finding submitted: deviation (NONCOMPETE, Section 6.1).**

- **Responsive locations checked:** Section 6 (Exclusivity) — 6.1 (p0037), 6.2 carve-out (p0040–p0041), 6.3 HDI covenant (p0042); plus trademark licence (p0038–p0039), editorial control (p0032), Globix acknowledgement (p0058). Only 6.1 binds us.
- **Why it fails:** 6.1 bars the Company from any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or open-ended "products substantially similar" (including unnamed "companies similar to" Wilson's/Excelled), and grants HDI an exclusive right in our own "Deerskin" brand — a field-of-use restriction that stops us using or licensing our own brand. Fallback also fails: scope is not a single named product, and there is no internal-development or acquisitions carve-out (6.2 covers only closeout merchandise). Term-only duration is the sole fallback element met. HDI's 6.3 restriction on the vendor is left intact.
- **Cure (preferred, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace of 6.1 with a short affirmative permission and removal of the brand exclusivity, preserving 6.2 and 6.3; the comment offers the narrowed fallback.
